description: Represented Alo Bhubon Trust as a technical expert during a high-level joint seminar focused on nationwide cancer prevention strategies. Supported the technical discourse surrounding the Trust's screening programs, emphasizing the operational requirements for remote diagnostic camps. Contributed to strategic discussions on procuring critical medical imaging hardware—including Mammography, X-ray, and Breast Elastography machines—to establish sustainable, early-detection infrastructure at the Rahima Baniz Health Care Center (RBHC) in Naogaon.
keyInitiatives: Advocated for the expansion of HPV vaccination and Self Breast Examination (SBE) programs targeting 25 million at-risk women.
Detailed the technical and financial logistics (approx. 37,690 BDT per camp) for executing remote screening initiatives for 70-100 women.
Fostered strategic partnerships with Rotary Clubs to sponsor vaccine doses and upgrade rural diagnostic technology.
